instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct form of each adjective.

hint.text:
If an adjective ends with a y, you have to change the y to an i before adding the ending -er or -est.

For example:
pretty → prettier → prettiest
hint.sound:
If an adjective ends with a why, you have to change the why, to an eye, before adding the ending -e r, or -e s t For example:
pretty becomes prettier, which becomes prettiest

atoms.b: Some adjectives do not form their comparatives and superlatives by adding -er or -est. Instead, they use the words ((++more many)) and ((++most all)) to build these forms.
Toby’s new teacher is ((more_assertive)) than his old one.
He realised that he had become ((more_modest)) and humble with time.
I wonder what’s inside, you’re ((more_excited)) than usual while handing over these gifts!
Although they can look cute, hippopotamuses are one of the ((most_ferocious)) animals on Earth.
This is the ((most_overjoyed)) Josh has ever seen his grandmother after a run.
This biology project was the ((most_laborious)) one I have ever had to do.
